description: This file defines test collection fixtures and a base fixture class for Azure-based integration tests in a project using Orleans and xUnit. It sets up shared test environments and ensures Azure Storage connectivity.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring shared test environment configuration and core Orleans setup.

classes.name: BaseAzureTestClusterFixture
classes.description: An abstract base fixture class for Azure-based integration tests, ensuring Azure Storage connectivity before tests run.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Overrides the method to check preconditions, including Azure Storage connectivity.
